review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 12:58 PM ET. It had Tar Heels 41% and Hurricanes 59%, projecting Tar Heels 1.5 – Hurricanes 1.9 (3.5 total, Hurricanes by 0.4).

Final: Tar Heels 1 – Hurricanes 3. Right winner: it had Hurricanes at 59%.

Hurricanes came in with a 14% above average attack and a 21% stingier than average defense (no scoring on file: rated at the league average), worth about 13 and 13 games of evidence. review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.095 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +1.8 sets. It counts toward Volleyball scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 776 graded Volleyball games the algo now scales scoring ×0.965 and gives home teams +0.2 sets. Team corrections so far: Tar Heels attack ×0.971, defense ×0.960 (7 games); Hurricanes attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (7 games).
